title: Love It! Sturdy and Easy to assemble. Looks exactly like the picture.
text: Love It! Sturdy and Easy to assemble. Looks exactly like the picture.. Actually pretty good exactly what I was looking for, I put it up and it was the easiest assemble I've seen in a while it was well packaged and looked like new no scratches or anything also good quality and sturdy so it's perfect! It took me a while to find one I liked online but this one is really nice, very pricey for what it is and the size to be quite honest though, but I like, I cannot complain about quality so that is good and at the very least you can actually sit on it and use it as intended.

product_metadata.title: H&B Luxuries Tufted Leather Square Flip Top Storage Ottoman Cube Foot Rest (Black)
features: The ottoman is an instant classic, offering a clean, inviting silhouette that works with any style.
This multi-purpose ottoman offers ample storage with an easy open top.
Anti-rust metal crank arm design prevents the falling top hit your hand.
Black round plastic legs extend the lifetime of the ottoman and will not mark or scratch the floors.
Overall dimensions: 17.32" × 17.32" × 14.57"(H); Interior size: 14.17" × 14.17" × 7.87"(H). Sturdy construction holds up to 440 lbs.
